name: IBIT Short Volume Ratio — BTC Sentiment Proxy
description: Research study tracking IBIT (iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF) short volume ratio as a Bitcoin sentiment indicator. Displays the daily short volume ratio (short volume / total volume) over time with a 20-day SMA overlay and a 50% reference line, plus a summary table of key statistics (average, max, min, current).
source:
# =============================================================================
# IBIT SHORT VOLUME RATIO — BTC SENTIMENT PROXY
# =============================================================================
# Short volume ratio (short volume / total volume) as a sentiment indicator
# for Bitcoin via the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF.
# Key levels: >50% = elevated bearish pressure, 30-45% = normal range
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# SHORT VOLUME DATA
# =============================================================================

sv_data = short_volume()()
sv_ratio = sv_data.short_volume_ratio   # Already in percentage units (0-100)

# 20-day SMA of short volume ratio
sv_sma20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(sv_ratio)

# Timestamp for x-axis
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# LINE CHART: Short Volume Ratio Over Time
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='IBIT Short Volume Ratio — BTC Sentiment Proxy',
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    y_axis_label='Short Volume Ratio (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Short Vol Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day SMA', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(sv_ratio, sv_sma20))

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Key Statistics
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='IBIT Short Volume Ratio Statistics',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Short Vol Ratio (%)'],
        col_headers=['Average', 'Max', 'Min', 'Current'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Short Volume Sentiment',
    order=1
)(sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio, sv_ratio)
